subject: INTEGER-OF-DATE function
notes: r1's whole content is §15.5.2, so the golden pins what §15.5.2 defines: 16010101 -> 1 (the stated starting date) and 99991231 -> 3067671 (the value the standard writes into its own text), plus all three §15.5.1 leap branches — 16040229 -> 1155, 20000229 -> 145791, and 17000228 -> 36218 with 17000301 -> 36219, consecutive because 1700 has no February 29 — and 19950215 -> 143951. Every INTEGER-OF-DATE line has an INTEGER-OF-DAY twin it must equal, since §15.5.2 defines ONE integer date form.
